newsitem.title: MEXICO: U.S. drugs czar arrives in Mexico for two-day visit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. drugs czar arrives in Mexico for two-day visit.

text.p: U.S. anti-drug chief Barry McCaffrey arrived in Mexico on Monday for a two-day bilateral meeting on a policy to fight narcotics.
McCaffrey, the director of the Office of National Drug Control Policy, was due to take part in the third meeting of the U.S.-Mexico High Level Anti-Narcotics Group on Tuesday and Wednesday.

McCaffrey, a retired army general, will likely meet his new Mexican counterpart, Gen. Jesus Gutierrez Rebollo of the elite Estado Mayor presidential guard, who was named to head Mexico's main anti-narcotics agency last week.
Mexican Attorney General Jorge Madrazo Cuellar, who was appointed last week to replace Antonio Lozano Gracia, will also take part in the meetings.
